name: BlackberryNOVA
source:
BlackberryNOVA: A yuri visual novel about a girl whom graduated from high school and is now preparing herself as she enters college.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/939870/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《BlackberryNOVA》是一部百合視覺小說，講述了一名剛從高中畢業、正為進入大學作準備的女孩的故事。

［摘自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/939870/]Steam[/url]］
